summary: Frontend-only E2E validation of the NEW JourneyMap (Google Maps itinerary visualization) on /transport-public. Login (test2@example.com), geoloc seeded near Université des Antilles (16.227,-61.518), 'Ma position actuelle' auto-prefilled, destination 'Aeroport Pole Caraibes Guadeloupe' picked via .pac-container autocomplete. journey-map renders inside journey-result, above journey-legs, with full Google Maps stack (.gm-style present, 17 tile imgs, 8 canvas) and visible polylines/markers (green origin, red destination, intermediate stops). Verdict + journey-book-vtc-btn navigate to /course?mode=standard. Zero real console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: JourneyMap.jsx: map height fixed at 200px — works for mobile, but on a long multi-leg trip (e.g. correspondance L2→L1 with wide bounds) the polyline can appear cramped. Consider 220-260px or dynamic based on legs.length.

JourneyMap reuses the same map instance across re-renders but never re-centers/zooms-out if plan switches to a totally different bounding box AND fitBounds throws (try/catch swallows it silently). Add a console.warn in catch for debuggability.
Polyline path uses leg.via coords directly with no decimation — fine for simulated short bus lines, but if a real GTFS shape with hundreds of points is wired later this should be simplified.

Origin/destination dot markers are drawn on top of intermediate stop dots (zIndex 50 vs 10) — good. But the green/red filled circles use scale=7 which can overlap when origin and destination are very close; not a regression, just noting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed measured layout (viewport 390x844): journey-map at y=581 h=202 (w=316), journey-legs at y=795 — map IS above legs as required. Google Maps loader is shared (GMAPS_LOADER_OPTIONS) and works without re-injecting the script. Login flow: /login → click 'Ou choisir une autre option' → 'Email & mot de passe' (this is the new modal label, NOT just 'Email') → fill email/password → 'Se connecter'. Geolocation must be granted + set before /transport-public for jFrom autoprefill. Trip tested: Univ Antilles → Aéroport Pôle Caraïbes => Bus ~58 min / 3.00 € / 1 correspondance, VTC ~15 min / 14.75 €, verdict 'gagner ~43 min · surcoût VTC 11.75 €'. journey-book-vtc-btn navigates to /course?mode=standard.
